classical_tamil: கடவுள் வாழ்த்து — இறைவனை வணங்கி, அறத்தின் வழி நிற்போம் என்ற தொடக்கப் பாடல்.
modern_tamil: கடவுளை வணங்கி, அறநெறியில் நிலைத்து நிற்போம் என்று கூறும் தொடக்கப் பாடல்.
english: An invocatory verse — we bow before the divine and pledge to stand on the path of virtue.
uri: Reverence and submission before cosmic moral order
dhvani_layer: The opening invocation establishes that all acts of war, generosity, and kingship that follow are subordinate to cosmic moral order.
cultural_context: Purananuru opens with a Kadavul Vaazhthu (divine invocation), a convention in Sangam anthologies. The poet sets the moral frame before 400 poems of kings, war, death, and generosity.
storytelling_seed_emotional: Before the wars begin, before the kings rise and fall — a single voice pauses to bow. Everything that follows is held within that silence.
visual_imagery: sacred flame in a dark temple
